name: lincoln-heights-studio-map
description: Independent, unofficial iOS map of artist studios in the Lincoln Heights arts district of Los Angeles.

scripts.ios:add: npx cap add ios && cp PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy ios/App/App/
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.ios:run: npm run build && npx cap run ios
